Camila / Neha — thanks for the ping. For CloudScale's ask, the following will work:

1) GL limits: 1,000,000 per occurrence / 2,000,000 aggregate (matches request)
2) Cyber: $2,000,000
3) Additional Insured: Commercial General Liability — CG 20 26 (or equivalent) naming "CloudScale, Inc., its officers, directors, employees, and agents" as additional insureds for liabilities arising out of our work.
4) Primary & non-contributory endorsement: acceptable. We should request wording indicating that the insurer's coverage is primary and non-contributory with respect to CloudScale for claims arising out of services performed by Redwood.
5) Waiver of subrogation: acceptable for general liability and auto (if carrier permits). For cyber, carriers sometimes decline — we'll accept carrier confirmation.

Attached is a clean endorsement template we recommend sending to the carrier. If they cannot issue CG 20 26, alternative wording that accomplishes the same effect is acceptable.

Markus Klein
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai

Hi Samantha — per legal, please ask your carrier to provide:

- COI showing: General Liability 1,000,000 / 2,000,000 aggregate; Cyber 2,000,000
- Additional Insured endorsement (CG 20 26 or equivalent) naming "CloudScale, Inc., its officers, directors, employees and agents"
- Primary & non-contributory wording on the endorsement
- Waiver of subrogation for GL/auto if carrier can accommodate (not required for cyber)

You can email the COI and endorsement to procurement@cloudscale.com and to our broker (insurance@redwood.ai) — if you prefer uploading, we'll accept a copy in your procurement portal.

For clarity, here's the exact sample endorsement line Markus suggested (carrier-friendly):

"The insurer agrees to endorse the policy to name CloudScale, Inc., its officers, directors, employees and agents as Additional Insureds with respect to liability arising out of the operations, products, or services performed by or on behalf of the Named Insured. Coverage provided to the Additional Insured shall be primary and non-contributory to any other insurance available to the Additional Insured."

If you can confirm carrier and expected ship date, we will keep the PO timeline moving. Happy to jump on a 15-min call if helpful.

Thanks,
Camila
